risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and provides detailed operating, cost, fuel, and credit-facility metrics, supporting relatively strong transparency. The tone is notably optimistic and promotional, with forward-looking beliefs about market share, pricing, and growth that may understate sensitivity to economic conditions, fuel costs, and shipment mix. Credit risk appears contained in the excerpt, with no borrowings outstanding at year-end, although financial covenants and letters of credit remain relevant obligations.
